part: final-c days 1-5 (Tokyo arrival, anime day, Toyota car day Fuji-Hakone-Daikoku, Kawasaki/Shibuya, Nozomi + Nara hill fire) + flights into Japan

issues.item: Girls Band Cry stamp book at Miharashi Park
issues.problem: Miharashi Park is an open park with no shop; the stamps are inside shops (only in their opening hours), and the fan shop 'GIRLS BAND CRY STAMP GALLERY' in Kawasaki Azalea opens only at 13:00 on weekdays, after you leave Kawasaki (about 12:40) on Fri Jan 22.
issues.evidence: https://girlsbandcrystamptour.com/ ; https://www.azalea.co.jp/shops/4018 (平日13:00～20:00、土日祝11:00～20:00) ; https://miraithings.com/view/category/gbcst (stamp book ¥500 online)
issues.fix: Buy the ¥500 stamp book at the first shop stamp spot or order it online before the trip, and stamp at Lazona and Marufuku Coffee. If you want the Stamp Gallery, move the East Exit part to 13:00 and leave Kawasaki at 13:45 (Shibuya Sky entry 14:40 still works, but Hachiko and Nintendo move to after the Sky visit).

issues.problem: With immigration, a 17:30 bus in evening traffic (65-90 min to Tokyo Station), the Chuo Line and the 10-min walk to Kabukicho, he reaches the hotel at about 19:20-19:30, so he gets to the Isetan food hall (closes 20:00) with only 15-20 min left.
issues.evidence: https://tyo-nrt.com/ (fastest 65 min, more in traffic) ; https://www.mistore.jp/store/shinjuku (Isetan 10:00-20:00, confirmed in check-a-1)
issues.fix: Skip the hotel stop: at Tokyo Station take the Marunouchi Line to Shinjuku-sanchome (exit into Isetan, about 20 min), shop, then check in after Don Quijote. UNIQLO Shinjuku Honten is open to 22:00, so shopping order stays the same.

issues.problem: The hotel page lists a coin laundry in the hotel ('コインランドリー' under facilities), so 'No washer in the hotel' and the walk to the 24 h laundry 150 m away are not needed.
issues.evidence: https://www.superhotel.co.jp/s_hotels/kabukicho/ (check-a-1 also saw coin laundry on 2F: washer ¥100, dryer free)
issues.fix: Change the laundry line to 'Coin laundry in the hotel' and do laundry night 1 there; drop the laundry-kabukicho stop.

issues.problem: The toll for a car on the Turnpike main line is ¥900, not ¥730.
issues.evidence: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/箱根ターンパイク (普通車・軽自動車 900円) ; https://www.htpl.co.jp (open 5:30-22:30)
issues.fix: Change the Taikanzan info line to 'toll ¥900'.

issues.problem: The official page says hours 'differ by season' and winter (Dec-Feb) hours are 10:00-19:00, not 10:00-20:00; your 11:35 visit is not affected.
issues.evidence: https://www.premiumoutlets.co.jp/gotemba/information/info245.html (10:00～20:00 ※季節により異なる, closed only 2027/2/25) ; check-a-1: gotemba.jp 10:00～19:00【12月～2月】
issues.fix: Change the info line to '10:00-19:00 in winter'. Goggles: Oakley, Salomon, Descente, Columbia, The North Face and Helly Hansen shops are on the brand list.

issues.item: Drive times Shinjuku -> Kawaguchiko and Taikanzan -> Chinatown
issues.problem: Free-flow times are 1 h 41 (107 km) and 1 h 32 (76 km); on a Thursday with morning traffic on Shuto Route 4 and afternoon traffic toward Yokohama, both legs are likely 15-30 min longer than the plan.
issues.evidence: router.project-osrm.org (Toyota Shinjuku-sanchome -> Oishi Park 107 km/101 min; Taikanzan -> Chinatown 76 km/92 min; Otome -> Taikanzan 26 min; Daikoku -> hotel 38 min)
issues.fix: Leave the shop at 08:10 (it opens 08:00) and leave Taikanzan by 14:30; Chinatown dinner then starts about 16:45-17:00, which still fits Daikoku at 19:15.

issues.problem: Police now close the Daikoku entrance on some weekday nights too, so a Thursday is not safe from closure.
issues.fix: Check X and the Shutoko site at 18:30; if closed, drive to Tatsumi 1st PA directly (about 35-40 min).

issues.problem: In Tokyo studless tyres are an extra option (¥2,200 per 24 h) with few cars, and the shop page does not list them; the plan books only by early December.
issues.fix: Book the car now (bookings are open 6 months ahead), add studless + ETC (¥550), and phone the shop (03-3341-2603) to confirm a studless car.

issues.problem: The case goes ahead on Jan 22 and meets him only on Jan 30, but the plan puts 'everything' from Tokyo in it; the goggles, ski gloves and warm layers are needed in Niseko on Jan 26-29, and the hotel must hold the parcel about 6 days.
issues.evidence: plan day 4 notes and Route-Inn bookFirst item (no source checked for Route-Inn: outside this part)
issues.fix: Keep all ski and warm gear in the backpack; put only souvenirs in the case. Ask Yamato for delivery on Jan 29 (date choice on the slip) so the hotel holds it only 1 day.

issues.problem: The January 2027 list is not out yet, so it is not certain there is a show that Wednesday; current shows are OPEN 18:30 / START 19:00, ADV ¥3,000 + drink.
issues.fix: When the list comes out in December, pick the show first and, if Jan 20 has none, swap day 2 with day 4 (Kawasaki/Shibuya) or use Shimokitazawa's other live houses (e.g. DAISY BAR, 251).

issues.problem: Sat Jan 23, 2027, fireworks 18:15, fire 18:30 matches the '4th Saturday' rule, but the source marks it 'being confirmed' and the Nara city page is not published yet.
issues.evidence: https://naratrip.com/wakakusayamayaki/ (2027年1月23日 18:15 花火, 18:30 点火, 荒天中止, 現在確認中)
issues.fix: Check the official Nara city / Nara tourism page in November before paying the Namba hotel; keep a free-cancellation rate.

issues.problem: The ¥32,840 Spring Airlines fare is the base fare; Spring's cheapest tickets include only a small cabin bag, and Aoki travels with a suitcase.
issues.fix: Book a fare with a checked bag (add about ¥3,000-5,000) and budget it.
